column1: # Video formats whose video track the TV may reject, with the message that wasm/wasmplayer.cpp then sends to the front
# end. Both sides read this file: FormatVideoTrackRejectedMessage() in wasm/video_track_rejection.hpp
# (tests/native/video_track_rejection_test.cpp) writes the message, and handleMessage() in wasm/platform/messages.js
# (tests/unit/video-track-rejection.test.js) reads it for the message of the error -200, so the two stay the same.
# Format, separated by tabs: the video format of moonlight-common-c (VIDEO_FORMAT_* in Limelight.h) in hex, the width,
# the height, the frame rate, the message.
